source: 761 The Blessings Festival
target: 761 Festum Benedictionum

source: 761 The Blessings Festival
target: 761 Festum Benedictionum

source: Beside a segment of the old city wall, now merely a relic for admiration, Lumian’s gaze passed between the tall and short gray‑white stone buildings and landed on a majestic temple standing near the mountain range.
target: Apud segmentum veteris muri urbis, nunc solum reliquiae ad admirationem, visus Lumiani inter alta et parva aedificia lapidea cinereo‑alba pertransiit et incidit in magnificum templum iuxta catena montium.

source: It towered thirty meters high, made up of several turrets, reminiscent of an ancient war fortress left over from bygone eras.
target: Triginta metra alta stabat, ex pluribus turribus compositum, quod antiquam arcem belli ex temporibus praeteritis relicta evocabat.

source: At this moment, influenced by both the mountains and the clouds, the near‑noon sunlight cast a dim hue, cloaking the grand temple in a dusk‑like veil.
target: Hoc ipso momento, montibus et nubibus simul afflatus, sol prope mediam diem pallidam umbram iaciebat, magnum templum in velamine crepusculari operiens.

source: “Is that a temple of the God of Combat?” Lumian didn’t turn his head as he asked the Knight of Swords beside him.
target: “Estne id templum Dei Pugnandi?” non vertit caput Lumian, dum equitem gladii iuxta se rogabat.

source: The God of Combat Church was the only state religion of the Feysac Empire, but following their defeat in the war a few years ago, the Evernight Goddess Church had gained a certain right to preach within the empire, although they seemed unenthusiastic about this role.
target: Ecclesia Dei Pugnandi erat sola religio publica Imperii Feysac, sed post cladem in bello paucis annis abhinc, Ecclesia Deae Noctis Aeternae certum ius intra imperium praedicandi adeptus est, quamquam huic muneri non videbantur ardenter incumbere.

source: The Knight of Swords replied succinctly, “It’s a cathedral.”
target: Eques Gladii breviter respondit: “Cathedrāla est.”

source: Not a temple, but a cathedral?
target: Non templum, sed cathedrāla?

source: True to the Feysacians, who suffer from a fascination with enormity, and their taste is not bad…
target: Feysaciani, qui admiratione ingentiae versantur, et cuius gustus non est male…

source: For some reason, Lumian suddenly recalled a phrase he had heard at the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society: More is beautiful, bigger is better.
target: Quamquam quaedam ratione, Lumian subito recordatus est locutionis quam audiverat apud Societatem Papionum Crispinorum: “Plus est pulchrum, majus est melius.”

source: He then asked, “Is this a Feysac colony?”
target: Tum rogavit: “Estne haec colonia Feysaciana?”

source: “Yes,” the Knight of Swords replied in a deep voice, “but now, the Loenese have the right to trade here.”
target: “Ita,” eques gladii voce profunda respondit, “sed nunc Loenenses ius habent hic mercandi.”

source: Lumian nodded slightly, saying nothing further as he followed the road into Raklev City.
target: Lumian leviter annuit, nihil amplius addens, dum viam in urbem Raklev sequebatur.

source: Along the way, it was easy for him to distinguish people from different countries among the crowd:
target: Per iter, facile ei erat homines ex diversis nationibus inter turbam distinguere:

source: • The Feysacians, tall in stature—men typically over six feet three inches, women nearly six feet—matched Lumian’s stereotype of them: descendants of giants, even including many half‑giants.
target: Feysaciani, qui altitudine egregia praediti erant—viri plerumque ultra sex pedes, quarum tres uncias ferent, et feminae paene sex pedum—stereotypum Lumiani de eis confirmabant: progenies gigantum, etiam multos semigiantes includentes.

source: • Their dressing tended to be casual, with either unbuttoned jackets or no jackets at all.
target: Indutiae eorum levis erant, sive vestimenta soluta gerentes vel omnino nulla induti.

source: • The Loenese, predominantly with black hair, cared much about their appearance, always impeccably dressed. The ladies favored round‑brimmed bonnets and carried sun‑blocking parasols, while the gentlemen were decked out in top hats and carried canes.
target: Loenenses, praesertim capillis nigris ornati, de specie sua multum curabant, semper impecstus vestiti. Feminae bonnetos rotundos cum latus amplo praeditos predilexerunt et parasolas solis repellentis portabant, dum viri in pileis altis ornatos et baculos ferentes erant.

source: • The locals of Raklev were darker‑skinned and wiry. The men often wore durable canvas work clothes, and the women dressed for labor, with only a few in brightly colored dresses, herding cattle, sheep, and horses.
target: Incolae Raklevenses cutis obscurae et graciles erant. Viri saepe induti erant vestimentis fortibus ex tela fabricatis, et feminae ad laborem aptae vestimenta gerebant, pauci tantum in vestibus vividis, pecora, oves, et equos gregantes.

source: Lumian watched a dwarf horse and several long‑haired cattle pass by, spotting a local man in a dark red robe with a stark white skull topped with a wool‑knit gray and white hat on his head.
target: Lumian aspexit equum nanum et plura pecora longis pilis transeunta, detegens hominem localem in veste rubeo obscura, cui calvaria alba, nitida, super caput, sub pileo ex lana cinerea et alba contextō, erat.

source: “Is this the remnant of Death worship you mentioned in the local customs?” Lumian didn’t choose his path deliberately but followed his instincts.
target: “Haecne remanentia cultus mortis, quem in consuetudinibus localibus memorasti?” Lumian iter non deliberatum eligebat, sed instinctibus se deduxit.

source: The Knight of Swords nodded slightly and said, “Yes, the people of Raklev keep the skulls of their deceased relatives at home, believing they protect them, bring good luck, and help fend off dangers lurking in the night.
target: Eques Gladii leviter annuit et dixit: “Ita, incolae Raklevenses domi calvariās cognatorum defunctorum servant, credentes eas eos protegere, fortunam bonam afferre, atque pericula nocturnis latentia repellere.”

source: The more skulls a family has, the more prosperous and developed it is considered.”
target: Quo plures calvariae familiae habentur, eo magis prospere et evoluta censentur.

source: This is similar to the practice in Cordu where relatives’ hair and nails are kept… but here, the Death worship is much stronger, hence the choice of skulls, making it more extreme…
target: Hoc simile est more in Cordu, ubi capilli et ungues cognatorum servantur… sed hic cultus mortis multo fortior est, ideo electio calvariarum id magis extremum reddit.

source: Lumian suddenly felt a pang of melancholy.
target: Lumian subito dolorem tristitiae sensit.

source: The Knight of Swords continued, “Some even make amulets from the skulls of their deceased kin to carry with them at all times.
target: Eques Gladii perrexit: “Quidam etiam amuleta ex calvariis cognatorum defunctorum faciunt, quae semper secum ferre solebant.”

source: What you saw earlier was just such a case.
target: Id quod antea vidisti, tale erat exemplum.

source: During the annual Blessing Festival, all the locals in Raklev take the skulls from their homes into the streets, dress them solemnly, and join in the revelry and prayers together.”
target: Durante festo annuo Benedictionum, omnes incolae Raklev calvariās ex domibus suis in vias ferunt, eas solemniter induunt, et in laetitia atque precibus congregantur.

source: “Blessing Festival?” Lumian perked up, asking with gravity.
target: “Festo Benedictionum?” Lumian excitatus graviter rogavit.

source: Having experienced Lent, Sea Prayer Festival, and Dream Festival, he felt like he had developed a sort of festival‑induced PTSD, with a headache starting whenever he heard of another special day.
target: Experiens Quadragesimam, Festum Precum Maris, et Festum Somniorum, sensit quasi ex festivitatibus PTSD ortum esse, cum capitis dolor incipere solebat quoties de alio die speciali audiret.

source: Oxyto, a Shaman King of the Rose School of Thought and a key follower of the Primordial Moon, couldn’t be staying in Raklev just for the Blessing Festival, could he?
target: Oxyto, Rex Schamanorum Scholae Rosae atque sectator praecipuus Lunae Primordialis, non potuit in Raklev manere tantum ob Festo Benedictionum, nonne?

source: The Knight of Swords responded somberly, “The Blessing Festival has long since passed; it was in November last year, more than a month before the Dream Festival.”
target: Eques Gladii graviter respondit: “Festo Benedictionum iam pridem transierit; fuit Novembri proximo anno, plus quam mense ante Festum Somniorum.”

source: You know about the Dream Festival… Lumian first breathed a sigh of relief, then asked anxiously, “Did Oxyto first appear in the Raklev area before or after the Blessing Festival?”
target: Scis de Festum Somniorum… Lumian primum leviter suspiravit, deinde anxie quaesivit: “Oxyto prius apparuit in regione Raklev ante an post Festo Benedictionum?”

source: The Knight of Swords thought for a moment before replying, “Before.”
target: Eques Gladii paulisper meditatus est, deinde respondit: “Ante.”

source: “So during the Blessing Festival, he was likely still in the Raklev area?” Lumian furrowed his brow slightly.
target: “Ita, ergo, Festo Benedictionum, probabiliter adhuc in regione Raklev mansit?” Lumian leviter fronte contraxit.

source: “That seems to be the case,” the Knight of Swords answered, very cautiously.
target: “Id videtur,” respondit eques gladii, cautissime.

source: Franca’s gaze drifted away from a local woman with colorful skulls sewn onto her shoulder, and she turned to a tall, blond, blue‑eyed woman from Feysac with a smile.
target: Francae oculus a muliere locali, cui in humero variī calvariae coloratī consuti erant, avertit, et illa ad mulierem altam, flavam, caeruleosque oculos ex Feysac, subrisu, se convertit.

source: “Sorry, I already have a lady companion!”
target: “Ignosce, iam comitissa habeo!”

source: Isn’t this Feysacian a bit too forthright?
target: Nonne hic Feysacianus paulo nimis aperte se exprimit?

source: Flirting with me and Jenna, and to think, aside from men, there were also beautiful women inviting us over!
target: Ludens mecum et cum Jenna, et cogitandum est, praeter viros etiam pulchrae feminae nos invitabant!

source: The Feysacian chuckled.
target: Feysacianus subridens risit.

source: “I don’t mind if you both come over to my place.”
target: “Mihi non molestum est, si uterque ad domum meam veniatis.”

source: “I mind,” Jenna spoke up for Franca.
target: “Mihi molestum est,” locuta est Jenna pro Franca.

source: They had been wandering around Raklev City for nearly two hours.
target: Per urbem Raklev fere per duas horas vagabantur.

source: Although Franca hadn’t actively unleashed the Demoness of Pleasure’s charm—to avoid suspicion of fishing purposefully—their carefully styled Demoness appearance alone, in terms of looks, demeanor, and figure, was enough to draw plenty of attention.
target: Quamquam Franca non actu Demonissam Voluptatis venustatem efferuerat – ut suspicio de piscatione deliberata evaderetur – tamen ipsa eleganter disposita species Demonissae, in specie, habitu, atque figura, satis erat ad multam attentionem alliciendam.

source: Here, the Feysacians were bold and direct, both men and women, while the Loenese were conservative and reserved, only daring to approach after finding a good reason.
target: Hic Feysaciani audaces et directi (viri et feminae) erant, dum Loenenses cauti et reticentes erant, tantum appropinquare audebant cum rationem bonam inveniissent.

source: The locals mostly just watched from a distance, quietly following, with a few gathering the courage to speak up, but only in the guise of offering guidance.
target: Incolae Raklevenses plerumque a longinquitate spectabant, tranquille sequi solebant, pauci audaciam conquisivērunt loquendi, sed tantum sub specie consilii praebendi.

source: “Alright then.”
target: Bene igitur.

source: The female Feysacian, a bit taller than Franca, waved her hand in disappointment and turned to enter a nearby café.
target: Femina Feysaciana, paululum Francae altior, manu languida taedio vibrante salutavit et ad cauponam prope positam se convertit.

source: Franca and Jenna were now in the heart of Raklev City, on a street that boasted the grand and elegant architectural style typical of Feysac.
target: Franca et Jenna nunc in corde urbis Raklev erant, in platea qua praevalebat magnus et elegans styla architectonica Feysaciana.

source: “It’s almost noon, how about trying some Feysac cuisine?”
target: Prope meridiem est; quid de cibis Feysacianis temptandis censes?

source: Franca looked up at the sun, bright but not warm.
target: Franca solem extulit, lucide sed non fervide.

source: She was referring to the St. Millom Restaurant diagonally across from them.
target: Ea referret ad St. Millom Restaurant, quod diagonaliter trans eos positum erat.

source: St. Millom was the capital of the Feysac Empire, and naming a restaurant after it seemed an attempt to offer an “authentic” experience.
target: St. Millom erat caput Imperii Feysac, et restaurantium eum nominare videbatur conari experientiam “authenticam” praebere.

source: “Sure.” Jenna nodded gently.
target: “Certe,” Jenna leniter annuit.

source: As the two Demonesses stepped into the grand and intricately decorated restaurant, Anthony sat down on a bench across the street and quietly started on his lunch—a corn tortilla wrapped around beef and lamb, seasoned with various spices.
target: Dum duae Demonissae in magnum et subtiliter ornatum restaurantum intraverunt, Anthony in subsello trans viam sedebat et silentio prandium suum inire coepit—tortilla maiziana involuta in carne bubula et agnellina, variis condimentis sapientibus.

source: Lumian walked with Ludwig and Lugano until they reached the temple‑like Holy Lake Cathedral.
target: Lumian cum Ludovico et Lugano ambulavit, donec ad Cathedralem Sacri Lacus, quasi templo similem, pervenerunt.

source: But once they truly entered the city, the Knight of Swords, Maric, disappeared.
target: Sed cum veram urbem intrarentur, Eques Gladii, Maric, evanuit.

source: However, Lumian’s instincts told him that this Minor Arcana card holder was still nearby.
target: Attamen, instinctus Lumiani ei indicaverunt hunc tenentem chartae Minoris Arcanae adhuc prope esse.

source: “Feeling anything unusual?” Lumian inquired of Ludwig.
target: “Sentisne aliquid inusitatum?” Lumian a Ludovico interrogavit.

source: “No,” Ludwig shook his head.
target: “Non,” Ludovicus caput concutiens respondit.

source: Lumian then turned to Lugano.
target: Lumian deinde ad Lugano se vertit.

source: “What about you?”
target: “Quid de te?”

source: “Me?” Lugano looked baffled.
target: “Mihi?” Lugano obstupuit.

source: Isn’t it Ludwig’s job to locate people?
target: Nonne officium Ludovico est homines quaerere?

source: What does this have to do with me?
target: Quid hoc ad me pertinet?

source: “Do you sense anything unusual?” Lumian calmly repeated the question.
target: “Sentisne aliquid inusitatum?” Lumian placide quaestionem repetivit.

source: For some reason, Lugano felt that his employer had become more approachable lately, so he honestly replied, “No.”
target: Aliqua ratione, Lugano sensit dominum suum nuper magis accesibilem factum esse, itaque sincere respondit: “Non.”

source: Gurgle, gurgle, a strange noise sounded next to both him and Lumian.
target: Gurgle, gurgle, sonus mirus prope eum et Lumian audiebatur.

source: Both turned their gaze to Ludwig.
target: Ambo ad Ludovicum oculos converterunt.

source: Touching his stomach, Ludwig looked eager and said, “It’s time for lunch.”
target: Tangentem ventrem, Ludovicus ardens videbatur et dixit: “Tempus prandi est.”

source: “Alright,” Lumian agreed readily.
target: “Optime,” Lumian pariter convenit.

source: His philosophy was to never let a child go hungry, especially since the starving child might resort to cannibalism.
target: Philosophia eius erat ne umquam puer famem pati haberet, praesertim quod puer esuriens ad anthropophagiam degredi posset.

source: He looked around and pointed towards a bustling street to the northwest of Holy Lake Square.
target: Circumspiciens et digito monstrans, versus viam ferventem ad septentrionalem occidentem Sacri Lacus Plateam indicavit.

source: “There seem to be quite a few restaurants there.”
target: Videtur ibi esse plures cauponae.

source: This time, Ludwig didn’t need Lugano’s hand‑holding; he scampered ahead with short strides, while Lumian followed at a leisurely pace, and Lugano trailed close behind.
target: Hoc tempore, Ludovicus manibus Luganoi non indigebat; celeriter per breves passus praecurrit, dum Lumian tarde sequebatur, et Lugano prope post se pergebat.

source: The street bore a very typical Feysac characteristic, complete with trees and benches, resembling a streetscape in the Northern Continent countries.
target: Via notam Feysacianam propriam habebat, cum arboribus et subselliis, similis scaenae viarum in regionibus Continenti Septentrionalis.

source: Lumian glanced around briefly and pointed with his chin to St. Millom Restaurant not far away.
target: Lumian breve circumspiciens et mento ad St. Millom Restaurant, non longe truatus, digitum extulit.

source: “Let’s try some Feysac cuisine.”
target: Conemur fercula Feysaciana.

source: “Okay.” Ludwig wiped his mouth.
target: “Optime,” Ludovicus os suum exlustrans respondit.

source: Suddenly, his eager expression turned to confusion, and his head moved left and right as if searching for something.
target: Subito, vultus eius ardens in confusionem versa est, et caput ad sinistram et dextram movebatur, quasi aliquid quaereret.

source: Lumian noticed this unusual behavior.
target: Lumian hanc insolitam ambulationem animadvertit.

source: “Why? Want an ice cream too?” he teased Ludwig.
target: “Cur? Et visne gelatum etiam?” ludibrio incisus, ad Ludovicum dixit.

source: Imitating Lugano’s usual demeanor, Ludwig pressed his voice down and said, “I think I sensed that child from the body, but it’s vague.”
target: Ludovicus, morem solitum Luganoi imitans, vocem demittens dixit: “Puto me illud puerum ex corpore sensitisse, sed incertum est.”

source: Sensed the bird‑clawed baby? Lumian looked around; there were no other children in sight, just Feysacians and locals, with a few from Loen scattered among them.
target: Sensisti puerum ungulis avium similem? Lumian circumspiciens animadvertit: nulli alii pueri apparuerunt, solum Feysaciani et incolae, cum paucis ex Loen inter eos dispersis.

source: There weren’t even any pregnant women around.
target: Ne quidem ulla femina gravida aderat.

source: Then, Ludwig added, “I can’t sense it anymore.”
target: Deinde Ludovicus addidit: “Hoc amplius sentire non possum.”

source: Had it moved beyond a thirty‑meter range?
target: Num ultra triginta metra migraverit?

source: Lumian thoughtfully withdrew his gaze.
target: Lumian cogitabunde oculos avertit.

source: If what we had just encountered was related to the bird‑clawed baby, then my own Omebella bloodline might have been sensed by the other…
target: Si id quod modo incidimus puero ungulis avium simili attinet, tunc stirps mea Omebella ab altero percepta fuisset.

source: Lumian nodded and smiled at Ludwig.
target: Lumian annuit et Ludovico subrisit.

source: “Let’s eat first, nothing’s more important than filling our bellies.”
target: “Primum edamus, nihil est magis momenti quam ventres nostros replemus.”

source: “Right!” For the first time, Ludwig felt that the godfather’s words resonated deeply with him.
target: “Recte!” Primo tempore, Ludovicus sensit verba patroni ei penitus resonare.

source: Upon entering St. Millom Restaurant, Lumian immediately noticed Franca and Jenna sitting in a conspicuous spot.
target: Intravit in St. Millom Restaurant, et statim animadvertit Francam et Jennam in loco conspicuo sedentes.

source: The carefully dressed Demonesses caught Lumian’s attention for an extra second.
target: Daemonissae diligenter indutae proximum momentum attentionis Lumiani ceperunt.

source: Meanwhile, he wondered to himself, Is this the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence?
target: Interim, cogitabat: “Estne haec lex de ‘Beyonder Characteristics Convergence’?”

source: How coincidental for us to choose the same restaurant…
target: Quam fortuito nobis idem restaurantum eligere convenit…

source: (Reader note: A reasonable development)
target: (Nota lectoris: Evolutio rationabilis.)

source: Franca and Jenna, noticing his gaze, looked back at him—one with a mouth agape in surprise, the other stifling a laugh.
target: Franca et Jenna, eius oculos animadvertere, in eum redeuntes vidērunt—una ore stupore aperto, altera risu suffocans.

source: They quickly composed themselves and turned their attention back to the beet soup in front of them.
target: Celeriter se componere coeperunt et animos ad ius betae coram eos redegerunt.

source: With the waiter’s guidance, Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano took a seat in the corner.
target: Ministri auxilio, Lumian, Ludovicus, et Lugano in angulo consederunt.

source: “Sir, what would you like to order?”
target: “Domine, quid vis ordinare?”

source: The waiter offered a menu designed like a book.
target: Serviens menùum, qui quasi liber formatus erat, obtulit.

source: Lumian glanced at it, chose not to browse through, and simply said, “One set of everything but the drinks.”
target: Lumian illud aspexit, non perlegens, et simpliciter dixit: “Unum exemplar omnium, excepto potionibus.”
